newsitem.title: USA: Princess says P&O orders new $320 mln ship.
newsitem.headline: Princess says P&O orders new $320 mln ship.

text.p: Princess Cruises on Thursday said its sister company, Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, has ordered a $320 million, superliner set for the United Kingdom market in 2000.

It will be the largest ship ever built for the U.K. market, and it brings P&O Group's investment in new ships for North America and Europe to $2.8 billion during the 1990s, Princess Cruises said in a statement.
The new ship has yet to be named. It will be built at the Meyer Werft shipyard in Germany, weigh about 76,000 tons and have a passenger capacity of 1,800.

The order follows the recent announcment of a fourth Sun Princess-classs ocean cruise liner, called the Ocean Princess. Princess' Grand Class expansion now is $1.6 billion with a capacity increase of over 60 percent between now and 2000.
After introduction of all ships on order or under construction, Peninsular & Orient's combined worldwide fleet will number 17 ships with about 25,000 berths.
